cases.spectre_deck:
simulator lang=spectre
ahdl_include "dut.va"
Vu (u 0) vsource type=pwl wave=[0 0 1 1]
Xdut (u y 0) m
simulatorOptions options reltol=1e-7 vabstol=1e-9 iabstol=1e-12 precision="%24.17g"
tran tran stop=1 maxstep=0.5 errpreset=conservative strobetimes=[0.2 0.7] strobeoutput=all
save time y time u
